paragraphs.en: The text-to-cad plugin gives your agent local workflows for generating 3D models as STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF files. It also does design for manufacturing checks, generates engineering drawings, and connects to popular 3D printing, sheet metal and CNC fabrication services.
paragraphs.zh: 文本生成 CAD（text-to-cad）插件为你的智能体提供本地工作流，用于生成 STEP、GLB、STL 或 3MF 格式的 3D 模型文件。 它还可以执行面向制造的设计检查、生成工程图纸，并连接到流行的 3D 打印、钣金和 CNC 制造服务。

sents.en: The text-to-cad plugin gives your agent local workflows for generating 3D models as STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF files.
sents.zh: 文本生成 CAD（text-to-cad）插件为你的智能体提供本地工作流，用于生成 STEP、GLB、STL 或 3MF 格式的 3D 模型文件。

sents.en: It also does design for manufacturing checks, generates engineering drawings, and connects to popular 3D printing, sheet metal and CNC fabrication services.
sents.zh: 它还可以执行面向制造的设计检查、生成工程图纸，并连接到流行的 3D 打印、钣金和 CNC 制造服务。

paragraphs.en: It is supported by all popular agents that support plugins or the skills framework, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and Grok.
paragraphs.zh: 所有支持插件或技能框架的主流智能体均支持它，包括 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini 和 Grok。

paragraphs.en: Send this message to your agent and it will install text-to-cad for you.
paragraphs.zh: 将此消息发送给你的智能体，它将为你安装 text-to-cad。

paragraphs.en: Install text-to-cad from https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad By default, text-to-cad sends usage stats and crash reports, tagged with a random ID and never including your files, paths or prompts; turn them off with uvx cadgen telemetry off , or ask your agent to. Telemetry says the rest.
paragraphs.zh: 从 https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad 安装 text-to-cad。默认情况下，text-to-cad 会发送使用统计和崩溃报告，并附带一个随机 ID，绝不包含你的文件、路径或提示词；可以通过 uvx cadgen telemetry off 关闭遥测，或者让你的智能体来操作。遥测说明其余内容。

paragraphs.en: The plugin for your agent app brings the skills and CAD's viewer, a local server ( cadgen mcp ). For an agent without a plugin, install the skills alone. Install one or the other in an app, not both: two copies means every skill twice.
paragraphs.zh: 你的智能体应用的插件会带来各项技能以及 CAD 查看器（一个本地服务器 cadgen mcp）。 对于没有插件的智能体，可单独安装这些技能。 在一个应用中二者只装其一，不要都装：装两份意味着每个技能出现两次。

sents.en: The plugin for your agent app brings the skills and CAD's viewer, a local server ( cadgen mcp ).
sents.zh: 你的智能体应用的插件会带来各项技能以及 CAD 查看器（一个本地服务器 cadgen mcp）。

sents.en: For an agent without a plugin, install the skills alone.
sents.zh: 对于没有插件的智能体，可单独安装这些技能。

sents.en: Install one or the other in an app, not both: two copies means every skill twice.
sents.zh: 在一个应用中二者只装其一，不要都装：装两份意味着每个技能出现两次。

paragraphs.en: The install commands below take the latest branch: it holds the plugin alone and gets each release once it is on PyPI. main , where development happens, installs too, but can hold changes that aren't released yet. Each app names the branch in its own way ( #latest , --ref latest , @latest or --branch latest ); leave it out and the app installs main .
paragraphs.zh: 下面的安装命令默认获取 latest 分支：它只包含插件本身，并会在每个版本发布到 PyPI 后同步更新。开发所在的 main 分支也可以安装，但其中可能包含尚未发布的更改。 每个应用都有自己的分支命名方式（#latest、--ref latest、@latest 或 --branch latest）；若省略该参数，应用将安装 main 分支。

sents.en: The install commands below take the latest branch: it holds the plugin alone and gets each release once it is on PyPI. main , where development happens, installs too, but can hold changes that aren't released yet.
sents.zh: 下面的安装命令默认获取 latest 分支：它只包含插件本身，并会在每个版本发布到 PyPI 后同步更新。开发所在的 main 分支也可以安装，但其中可能包含尚未发布的更改。

sents.en: Each app names the branch in its own way ( #latest , --ref latest , @latest or --branch latest ); leave it out and the app installs main .
sents.zh: 每个应用都有自己的分支命名方式（#latest、--ref latest、@latest 或 --branch latest）；若省略该参数，应用将安装 main 分支。

paragraphs.en: Each app's heading also says how to update text-to-cad, and how to reinstall it: remove it, then install it again. Updating the plugin updates CAD: the new release's cadgen is downloaded the first time it runs, and the skills and the server share it. Earlier releases stay in uv's cache until you run uv cache prune .
paragraphs.zh: 每个应用的标题还会说明如何更新文本转 CAD，以及如何重新安装它：先移除，再重新安装。 更新插件即更新 CAD：新版本的 cadgen 会在首次运行时下载，技能与服务端共享该文件。 旧版本会保留在 uv 的缓存中，直到你运行 uv cache prune。

sents.en: Each app's heading also says how to update text-to-cad, and how to reinstall it: remove it, then install it again.
sents.zh: 每个应用的标题还会说明如何更新文本转 CAD，以及如何重新安装它：先移除，再重新安装。

sents.en: Updating the plugin updates CAD: the new release's cadgen is downloaded the first time it runs, and the skills and the server share it.
sents.zh: 更新插件即更新 CAD：新版本的 cadgen 会在首次运行时下载，技能与服务端共享该文件。

sents.en: Earlier releases stay in uv's cache until you run uv cache prune .
sents.zh: 旧版本会保留在 uv 的缓存中，直到你运行 uv cache prune。

paragraphs.en: claude plugin marketplace add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest claude plugin install text-to-cad@earthtojake The plugin also starts CAD's server. Where Claude Code can show app views, CAD shows models as viewer cards in the conversation; otherwise, as in a terminal, asking it to show a model gives you a link that opens the model in the CAD Viewer in your browser.
paragraphs.zh: claude plugin marketplace add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest claude plugin install text-to-cad@earthtojake 该插件还会启动 CAD 的服务器。 在 Claude Code 可以显示应用视图的地方，CAD 会在对话中以查看器卡片的形式显示模型；否则（例如在终端中），要求它显示模型会给你一个链接，可在浏览器中的 CAD 查看器里打开该模型。

sents.en: claude plugin marketplace add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest claude plugin install text-to-cad@earthtojake The plugin also starts CAD's server.
sents.zh: claude plugin marketplace add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest claude plugin install text-to-cad@earthtojake 该插件还会启动 CAD 的服务器。

sents.en: Where Claude Code can show app views, CAD shows models as viewer cards in the conversation; otherwise, as in a terminal, asking it to show a model gives you a link that opens the model in the CAD Viewer in your browser.
sents.zh: 在 Claude Code 可以显示应用视图的地方，CAD 会在对话中以查看器卡片的形式显示模型；否则（例如在终端中），要求它显示模型会给你一个链接，可在浏览器中的 CAD 查看器里打开该模型。

paragraphs.en: To update, run these, then restart Claude Code:
paragraphs.zh: 要更新，请运行以下命令，然后重启 Claude Code：

paragraphs.en: claude plugin marketplace update earthtojake claude plugin update text-to-cad@earthtojake To reinstall, remove it with these, then run the install commands again:
paragraphs.zh: claude plugin marketplace update earthtojake claude plugin update text-to-cad@earthtojake 如需重新安装，请先用以下命令将其移除，然后再次运行安装命令：

paragraphs.en: claude plugin uninstall text-to-cad@earthtojake claude plugin marketplace remove earthtojake Claude Desktop CAD shows models in the chat: ask Claude to show one and it appears as a viewer card you can orbit, add to your prompt, and open full size; Claude can read what you selected and see what you see. It runs locally through uv: add the server to Claude Desktop's config (Settings > Developer > Edit Config), then restart the app. If Claude Desktop cannot find uvx , give its full path ( which uvx ).
paragraphs.zh: claude plugin uninstall text-to-cad@earthtojake claude plugin marketplace remove earthtojake Claude Desktop 在聊天中显示 CAD 模型：让 Claude 展示一个模型，它会以查看器卡片的形式出现，你可以旋转查看、将其添加到提示词中，并全尺寸打开；Claude 能读取你选中的内容，并看到你所看到的画面。 它通过 uv 在本地运行：将该服务器添加到 Claude Desktop 的配置中（设置 > 开发者 > 编辑配置），然后重启应用。 如果 Claude Desktop 找不到 uvx，请提供其完整路径（which uvx）。

sents.en: claude plugin uninstall text-to-cad@earthtojake claude plugin marketplace remove earthtojake Claude Desktop CAD shows models in the chat: ask Claude to show one and it appears as a viewer card you can orbit, add to your prompt, and open full size; Claude can read what you selected and see what you see.
sents.zh: claude plugin uninstall text-to-cad@earthtojake claude plugin marketplace remove earthtojake Claude Desktop 在聊天中显示 CAD 模型：让 Claude 展示一个模型，它会以查看器卡片的形式出现，你可以旋转查看、将其添加到提示词中，并全尺寸打开；Claude 能读取你选中的内容，并看到你所看到的画面。

sents.en: It runs locally through uv: add the server to Claude Desktop's config (Settings > Developer > Edit Config), then restart the app.
sents.zh: 它通过 uv 在本地运行：将该服务器添加到 Claude Desktop 的配置中（设置 > 开发者 > 编辑配置），然后重启应用。

sents.en: If Claude Desktop cannot find uvx , give its full path ( which uvx ).
sents.zh: 如果 Claude Desktop 找不到 uvx，请提供其完整路径（which uvx）。

paragraphs.en: { "mcpServers" : { "cad" : { "command" : " uvx " , "args" : [ " --no-config " , " --managed-python " , " --python " , " 3.13 " , " --from " , " cadgen==0.7.26 " , " cadgen " , " mcp " ], "env" : { "CADGEN_INSTALL_CHANNEL" : " claude-desktop " } } } } The config pins a cadgen release in args , and uvx keeps the version it first downloads. To update, change that version to the latest release , then restart Claude Desktop.
paragraphs.zh: { "mcpServers" : { "cad" : { "command" : " uvx " , "args" : [ " --no-config " , " --managed-python " , " --python " , " 3.13 " , " --from " , " cadgen==0.7.26 " , " cadgen " , " mcp " ], "env" : { "CADGEN_INSTALL_CHANNEL" : " claude-desktop " } } } } 该配置在 args 中固定了 cadgen 的发布版本，uvx 会保留它首次下载的版本。 如需更新，请将该版本号改为最新发布版本，然后重启 Claude Desktop。

sents.en: To update, change that version to the latest release , then restart Claude Desktop.
sents.zh: 如需更新，请将该版本号改为最新发布版本，然后重启 Claude Desktop。

paragraphs.en: Install text-to-cad from Codex's plugin directory: text-to-cad for Codex , then Open in desktop app .
paragraphs.zh: 从 Codex 的插件目录安装 text-to-cad：text-to-cad for Codex，然后点击 Open in desktop app。

paragraphs.en: In the Codex app the plugin also brings the CAD viewer: CAD in the sidebar (recent models, and Open), a CAD tab beside each thread that the agent drives, and Open with CAD for model files.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Codex 应用中，该插件还带来了 CAD 查看器：侧边栏中的 CAD（最近模型和打开）、每个智能体所驱动的会话旁边的 CAD 标签页，以及针对模型文件的「用 CAD 打开」。

paragraphs.en: codex plugin marketplace add earthtojake/text-to-cad --ref latest codex plugin add text-to-cad@earthtojake To update, upgrade the earthtojake marketplace (or use Plugins › Manage › Marketplace), then restart Codex:
paragraphs.zh: codex plugin marketplace add earthtojake/text-to-cad --ref latest codex plugin add text-to-cad@earthtojake 如需更新，请升级 earthtojake 市场（或使用「Plugins › Manage › Marketplace」），然后重启 Codex：

paragraphs.en: codex plugin marketplace upgrade earthtojake To reinstall, remove it with these, then run the install commands again:
paragraphs.zh: codex plugin marketplace upgrade earthtojake 如需重新安装，请先用以下命令将其移除，然后再次运行安装命令：

paragraphs.en: codex plugin remove text-to-cad@earthtojake codex plugin marketplace remove earthtojake The marketplace was renamed from text-to-cad to earthtojake ; if you added it before, remove the old one first ( codex plugin marketplace remove text-to-cad ).
paragraphs.zh: codex plugin remove text-to-cad@earthtojake codex plugin marketplace remove earthtojake 该市场（marketplace）已从 text-to-cad 更名为 earthtojake；如果你之前添加过旧版，请先移除旧版（codex plugin marketplace remove text-to-cad）。

paragraphs.en: Cursor also loads the plugin installed with Claude Code. If the Claude Code plugin is installed, Cursor already has text-to-cad: skip this.
paragraphs.zh: Cursor 也会加载随 Claude Code 安装的插件。 如果已安装 Claude Code 插件，Cursor 已经具备文本转 CAD 功能：跳过此步骤。

sents.en: Cursor also loads the plugin installed with Claude Code.
sents.zh: Cursor 也会加载随 Claude Code 安装的插件。

sents.en: If the Claude Code plugin is installed, Cursor already has text-to-cad: skip this.
sents.zh: 如果已安装 Claude Code 插件，Cursor 已经具备文本转 CAD 功能：跳过此步骤。

paragraphs.en: git clone --depth 1 --branch latest https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad Cursor reads .cursor-plugin/plugin.json : restart Cursor after cloning. Teams can import the repository instead, under Dashboard → Plugins & MCPs → Team Marketplaces .
paragraphs.zh: git clone --depth 1 --branch latest https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad Cursor 会读取 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json：克隆后请重启 Cursor。 团队也可以改为导入该仓库，路径为 Dashboard → Plugins & MCPs → Team Marketplaces。

sents.en: git clone --depth 1 --branch latest https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad Cursor reads .cursor-plugin/plugin.json : restart Cursor after cloning.
sents.zh: git clone --depth 1 --branch latest https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad Cursor 会读取 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json：克隆后请重启 Cursor。

sents.en: Teams can import the repository instead, under Dashboard → Plugins & MCPs → Team Marketplaces .
sents.zh: 团队也可以改为导入该仓库，路径为 Dashboard → Plugins & MCPs → Team Marketplaces。

paragraphs.en: To update, pull the latest release, then restart Cursor:
paragraphs.zh: 如需更新，请拉取最新版本，然后重启 Cursor：

paragraphs.en: git -C ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad pull To reinstall, delete the folder, then run the install command again:
paragraphs.zh: git -C ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad pull 如需重新安装，请先删除该文件夹，然后再次运行安装命令：

paragraphs.en: rm -rf ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad Grok Build Grok Build also loads the plugin installed with Claude Code. If the Claude Code plugin is installed, Grok Build already has text-to-cad: skip this.
paragraphs.zh: 执行 rm -rf ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad。Grok Build 也会加载通过 Claude Code 安装的插件。 如果已安装 Claude Code 插件，Grok Build 已具备 text-to-cad 功能：可跳过此步骤。

sents.en: rm -rf ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad Grok Build Grok Build also loads the plugin installed with Claude Code.
sents.zh: 执行 rm -rf ~ /.cursor/plugins/local/text-to-cad。Grok Build 也会加载通过 Claude Code 安装的插件。

sents.en: If the Claude Code plugin is installed, Grok Build already has text-to-cad: skip this.
sents.zh: 如果已安装 Claude Code 插件，Grok Build 已具备 text-to-cad 功能：可跳过此步骤。

paragraphs.en: grok plugin install earthtojake/text-to-cad@latest --trust grok plugin enable text-to-cad Grok Build reads the Claude plugin manifest. Grok shows tool results as text, so asking it to show a model gives you a CAD Viewer link.
paragraphs.zh: grok plugin install earthtojake/text-to-cad@latest --trust grok plugin enable text-to-cad Grok Build 会读取 Claude 插件清单。 Grok 会将工具结果以文本形式显示，因此要求它展示模型时，你会得到一个 CAD Viewer 链接。

sents.en: grok plugin install earthtojake/text-to-cad@latest --trust grok plugin enable text-to-cad Grok Build reads the Claude plugin manifest.
sents.zh: grok plugin install earthtojake/text-to-cad@latest --trust grok plugin enable text-to-cad Grok Build 会读取 Claude 插件清单。

sents.en: Grok shows tool results as text, so asking it to show a model gives you a CAD Viewer link.
sents.zh: Grok 会将工具结果以文本形式显示，因此要求它展示模型时，你会得到一个 CAD Viewer 链接。

paragraphs.en: To update, run this, then restart Grok Build:
paragraphs.zh: 要更新，请运行此命令，然后重启 Grok Build：

paragraphs.en: grok plugin update text-to-cad To reinstall, remove it with this, then run the install commands again:
paragraphs.zh: grok plugin update text-to-cad 如需重新安装，请先用此命令将其移除，然后再运行安装命令：

paragraphs.en: grok plugin uninstall text-to-cad Gemini gemini extensions install https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad --ref latest --consent --auto-update Gemini installs the plugin as an extension, with the skills and CAD's server, and keeps it up to date ( --auto-update ; --consent answers its security prompt). Like Grok, it shows tool results as text, so asking it to show a model gives you a CAD Viewer link.
paragraphs.zh: grok plugin uninstall text-to-cad Gemini gemini extensions install https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad --ref latest --consent --auto-update Gemini 将该插件作为扩展安装，包含相关技能和 CAD 的服务器，并保持其最新（--auto-update；--consent 用于回答其安全提示）。 与 Grok 一样，它以文本形式显示工具结果，因此要求它展示模型时会给你一个 CAD Viewer 链接。

sents.en: grok plugin uninstall text-to-cad Gemini gemini extensions install https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad --ref latest --consent --auto-update Gemini installs the plugin as an extension, with the skills and CAD's server, and keeps it up to date ( --auto-update ; --consent answers its security prompt).
sents.zh: grok plugin uninstall text-to-cad Gemini gemini extensions install https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad --ref latest --consent --auto-update Gemini 将该插件作为扩展安装，包含相关技能和 CAD 的服务器，并保持其最新（--auto-update；--consent 用于回答其安全提示）。

sents.en: Like Grok, it shows tool results as text, so asking it to show a model gives you a CAD Viewer link.
sents.zh: 与 Grok 一样，它以文本形式显示工具结果，因此要求它展示模型时会给你一个 CAD Viewer 链接。

paragraphs.en: To update now, run this, then restart Gemini:
paragraphs.zh: 如需立即更新，请运行此命令，然后重启 Gemini：

paragraphs.en: gemini extensions update text-to-cad To reinstall, remove it with this, then run the install command again:
paragraphs.zh: gemini 扩展更新 text-to-cad 如需重新安装，请先用此命令移除它，然后再次运行安装命令：

paragraphs.en: gemini extensions uninstall text-to-cad Other Agents For an agent without plugin support: the skills give you everything you need for core CAD workflows and let you view CAD files in a localhost web app. Install them with the Skills CLI:
paragraphs.zh: gemini extensions uninstall text-to-cad 其他智能体 对于不支持插件的智能体：这些技能为你提供了核心 CAD 工作流所需的一切，并让你能在本地主机的网页应用中查看 CAD 文件。 使用 Skills CLI 安装它们：

sents.en: gemini extensions uninstall text-to-cad Other Agents For an agent without plugin support: the skills give you everything you need for core CAD workflows and let you view CAD files in a localhost web app.
sents.zh: gemini extensions uninstall text-to-cad 其他智能体 对于不支持插件的智能体：这些技能为你提供了核心 CAD 工作流所需的一切，并让你能在本地主机的网页应用中查看 CAD 文件。

sents.en: Install them with the Skills CLI:
sents.zh: 使用 Skills CLI 安装它们：

paragraphs.en: npx skills add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest The command asks which agents to install for, and where. To skip the questions, name the agent and install for your user: npx skills add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest -g -a <agent> -y .
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest 该命令会询问为哪些智能体安装，以及安装到哪里。 若要跳过提问，请指定智能体名称并为你的用户安装：npx skills add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest -g -a <agent> -y .

sents.en: npx skills add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest The command asks which agents to install for, and where.
sents.zh: npx skills add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest 该命令会询问为哪些智能体安装，以及安装到哪里。

sents.en: To skip the questions, name the agent and install for your user: npx skills add earthtojake/text-to-cad#latest -g -a <agent> -y .

paragraphs.en: Each skill runs cadgen through uv with the same pinned command the plugin's server uses, so uv must be installed. Without the plugin there is no CAD server, so the skills open models in the CAD Viewer in your browser.
paragraphs.zh: 每个技能都通过 uv 以与插件服务器相同的固定命令运行 cadgen，因此必须安装 uv。 没有插件就没有 CAD 服务器，因此这些技能会在浏览器中的 CAD 查看器里打开模型。

sents.en: Each skill runs cadgen through uv with the same pinned command the plugin's server uses, so uv must be installed.
sents.zh: 每个技能都通过 uv 以与插件服务器相同的固定命令运行 cadgen，因此必须安装 uv。

sents.en: Without the plugin there is no CAD server, so the skills open models in the CAD Viewer in your browser.
sents.zh: 没有插件就没有 CAD 服务器，因此这些技能会在浏览器中的 CAD 查看器里打开模型。

paragraphs.en: To update or reinstall, run the same command again , then restart the app. add re-fetches the package and overwrites what is already installed, so it both refreshes existing skills and installs any skill added in a newer release. npx skills update only refreshes skills already in your lockfile, so it silently misses new ones — which matters here, because releases do add skills.
paragraphs.zh: 若要更新或重新安装，请再次运行同一命令，然后重启应用。add 会重新获取该包并覆盖已安装的内容，因此它既能刷新现有技能，也会安装较新版本中新增的技能。而 npx skills update 只会刷新锁文件中已有的技能，因此会静默遗漏新增的技能——这一点在这里很重要，因为版本发布确实会添加新技能。

paragraphs.en: Neither command removes a skill that was retired upstream; drop one with npx skills remove <skill> if you need to. The retired cad-viewer skill is now covered by the CAD, DXF and robot-description skills, and the retired cad-mcp-setup by this README's install and update steps. Remove old standalone installs with npx skills remove cad-viewer cad-mcp-setup .
paragraphs.zh: 两个命令都不会移除已在上游被弃用的技能；如有需要，可使用 npx skills remove <skill> 手动删除。 已弃用的 cad-viewer 技能现在由 CAD、DXF 和 robot-description 技能覆盖，已弃用的 cad-mcp-setup 则由本 README 的安装和更新步骤覆盖。 使用 npx skills remove cad-viewer cad-mcp-setup 移除旧的独立安装。

paragraphs.en: No plugin for your agent yet? Request one .
paragraphs.zh: 您的智能体还没有插件吗？可以请求一个 。

paragraphs.en: To update, ask your agent to update text-to-cad, or run the update commands under your app's heading, then restart the app.
paragraphs.zh: 要更新，请让您的智能体更新 text-to-cad，或在您应用对应的标题下运行更新命令，然后重启应用。

paragraphs.en: When a newer release is out, a copy you installed yourself says so: a blue update button, first in CAD's navbar and on its home, whose Send to agent posts "Update text-to-cad to 0.9.0 from https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad " to your chat, worded like the install message (the browser viewer's copies it instead), or, in an app that shows CAD's replies as text, a line with its reply. Your agent then runs the update commands under your app's heading here. The button also links to the install instructions , to update by hand. Copies from a plugin directory or the Cursor Marketplace never show it, since their store updates them, and neither does Gemini's extension, which Gemini updates: for those there is nothing to run.
paragraphs.zh: 当有更新的版本发布时，你自行安装的副本会提示你：CAD 导航栏及其主页上首先出现一个蓝色更新按钮，其 Send to agent 会向你的聊天发送「Update text-to-cad to 0.9.0 from https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad 」，措辞与安装消息类似（浏览器查看器中的副本则改为复制它），或者在以文本形式显示 CAD 回复的应用中，显示包含其回复的一行内容。 然后，你的智能体会在本文中你所用应用的标题下运行更新命令。 该按钮还链接到安装说明，以便手动更新。 来自插件目录或 Cursor Marketplace 的副本从不显示该按钮，因为它们的商店会为其更新；Gemini 的扩展也不会显示，因为 Gemini 会为其更新：对于这些情况，无需运行任何内容。

paragraphs.en: To find out, cadgen fetches api.texttocad.dev/v1/versions at most once a day: one anonymous request, with no ID, path or anything about you, never in CI and never for a copy that something else updates. CADGEN_UPDATE_CHECK=0 turns it off.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，cadgen 每天最多获取一次 api.texttocad.dev/v1/versions：一次匿名请求，不包含 ID、路径或任何关于你的信息，从不在 CI 中进行，也从不针对由其他程序更新的副本。 CADGEN_UPDATE_CHECK=0 可将其关闭。

sents.zh: 为此，cadgen 每天最多获取一次 api.texttocad.dev/v1/versions：一次匿名请求，不包含 ID、路径或任何关于你的信息，从不在 CI 中进行，也从不针对由其他程序更新的副本。

sents.en: CADGEN_UPDATE_CHECK=0 turns it off.
sents.zh: CADGEN_UPDATE_CHECK=0 可将其关闭。

paragraphs.en: The CAD app (the plugin's cad server), the browser viewer ( cadgen viewer ) and the build daemon that builds for them and for every cadgen command send usage stats by default, tagged with a random install ID: versions, where you installed it from (as the plugin's CAD app names it, noted in cadgen's state folder for the other two), your OS and agent app, and counts -- how often each CAD tool was called and why a call failed (one of a fixed set of words, such as "no file at that path" or "no view open", never its message), how often views were used, how many files of each format were shown, how many models were built and snapshots rendered, how those ended, why one failed (again a fixed word, such as "the model's code raised" or "the geometry kernel refused", never its message) and how long they took, which features were used -- added up over a few minutes before they are sent, each batch under a random ID of its own and the time it was made, so one sent again is counted once. When cadgen's own code fails, they also send a crash report: the error's type and where in cadgen (or Python, or one of its dependencies) it failed, never its message, and with any of your own code a bare placeholder. Our server adds the country each request comes from (worked out from its IP address, which it doesn't keep) and stores it all with PostHog. Never file names, paths, contents or prompts. The first cadgen command says so once, and sending starts then. Turn it off, which also deletes what was sent, with uvx cadgen telemetry off , Share usage stats in either app's menu (the logo at the top left, over any model), or by asking your agent. DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or CADGEN_TELEMETRY=0 turns it off for one process, and CADGEN_TELEMETRY=1 on, without changing your setting; nothing is sent by default in CI or from a development install. Nothing waits to send: what a command counts without the build daemon, and what any part of cadgen counted since its last send when it exits, waits in small files in cadgen's state folder until the next part of cadgen sends it in the background; turning telemetry off deletes them. Offline, nothing is sent and everything works. See the privacy policy .
paragraphs.zh: CAD 应用（即插件中的 cad server）、浏览器查看器（cadgen viewer），以及为它们和每条 cadgen 命令执行构建的构建守护进程，默认都会发送使用统计，并附带一个随机的安装 ID：包括版本号、安装来源（按插件的 CAD 应用所用的名称，另外两者的则记录在 cadgen 的状态文件夹中）、你的操作系统和智能体应用，以及各种计数——每个 CAD 工具被调用的频率和调用失败的原因（一组固定词语之一，例如「该路径下没有文件」或「没有打开的视图」，绝不包含其消息）、视图被使用的频率、展示了多少种各格式的文件、构建了多少模型、渲染了多少快照、这些操作如何结束、失败原因（同样是固定词语，例如「模型代码抛出了异常」或「几何内核拒绝执行」，绝不包含其消息）以及耗时，以及使用了哪些功能——这些数据会在发送前累计几分钟，每批发送都带有各自随机的批次 ID 和记录时间，因此重复发送的内容只会计一次。 当 cadgen 自身的代码出错时，它们还会发送崩溃报告：错误的类型以及错误发生在 cadgen（或 Python，或其某个依赖项）中的位置，绝不包含错误消息；凡涉及你自己的代码，则以一个空占位符代替。 我们的服务器会为每个请求添加其来源国家（由 IP 地址推算得出，IP 本身不会被保存），并将全部数据存储到 PostHog。 绝不收集文件名、路径、内容或提示词。 第一条 cadgen 命令会提示一次，随后开始发送。 可以用 uvx cadgen telemetry off 关闭遥测（同时删除已发送的数据），可以在任一应用的菜单（左上角的标志，位于任何模型之上）中关闭 Share usage stats，也可以让智能体帮你关闭。 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 或 CADGEN_TELEMETRY=0 可对单个进程关闭遥测，CADGEN_TELEMETRY=1 则开启，都不会更改你的设置；在 CI 环境或开发安装中默认不发送任何数据。 发送不会造成任何等待：命令在不依赖构建守护进程情况下统计的内容，以及 cadgen 任意部分在退出时自上次发送以来统计的内容，都会以小文件的形式存放在 cadgen 的状态文件夹中，直到 cadgen 的下一部分在后台将其发出；关闭遥测会删除这些文件。 离线时不发送任何数据，一切功能照常工作。参见隐私政策。

paragraphs.en: The CAD kernel behind the cad , dxf , urdf , srdf and sdf skills is OCP , OpenCascade's Python binding, and its wheel ships an unsigned native module. Windows 11's Smart App Control blocks unsigned native code, so on a machine where it is on (the default on a fresh install) every cadgen command and import build123d fails with ImportError: DLL load failed while importing OCP , and Event Viewer records the refusal as Event ID 3077 under CodeIntegrity › Operational. cadgen doctor names this when it sees it.
paragraphs.zh: cad、dxf、urdf、srdf 和 sdf 技能背后的 CAD 内核是 OCP，即 OpenCascade 的 Python 绑定，其 wheel 包附带一个未签名的原生模块。 Windows 11 的智能应用控制会拦截未签名的原生代码，因此在启用该功能的机器上（全新安装时的默认状态），每个 cadgen 命令和导入 build123d 都会失败并报 ImportError: DLL load failed while importing OCP，事件查看器会在 CodeIntegrity › Operational 下将该拒绝记录为事件 ID 3077。cadgen doctor 在检测到这种情况时会指出这一点。

paragraphs.en: Smart App Control has no per-app exception. Either turn it off (Settings › Privacy & security › Windows Security › App & browser control › Smart App Control settings; once off it can only be turned back on by reinstalling Windows) or run the CAD skills under WSL, where it does not apply. The wheel is built by the cadquery-ocp project, so signing it is not something this repository can do.
paragraphs.zh: 智能应用控制没有针对单个应用的例外设置。 你要么将其关闭（设置 › 隐私和安全性 › Windows 安全中心 › 应用和浏览器控制 › 智能应用控制设置；一旦关闭，只能通过重新安装 Windows 才能重新开启），要么在 WSL 下运行 CAD 技能，因为它不适用于 WSL。 该 wheel 包由 cadquery-ocp 项目构建，因此为本仓库无法对其进行签名。
